title: Ticket price
description:
A cinema charges by age:

| Age | Price |
|---|---|
| under 5 | 0 |
| 5 to 17 | 8 |
| 18 to 64 | 12 |
| 65 and over | 6 |

Read an age and print the price (just the number).

You have not met `if` yet, and you do not need it: chain the conditional operator.

```cpp
int price{ age < 5 ? 0 : (age < 18 ? 8 : ...) };
```
hints: Read a chained conditional from left to right: "is it under 5? then 0. Otherwise, is it under 18? then 8. Otherwise ..."
